context:
Core-orchestration + sandbox-monitor + QEMU tests. Context:

- compiled_yara_protocol: compile REAL yara rules with the real yara module and assert a real match/no-match over real bytes; the protocol/serialization is the unit - assert its exact encoded form against an independent reconstruction.

- sandbox monitor stop_event: drive the real monitor's start/stop lifecycle and assert the concrete state transition (thread stopped, event set, no further records), not that a flag exists.

- QEMU tests (anti_evasion_profile, logs_stable, start_calls_agent_connect): the QEMU process / agent socket is the ONLY permitted double - stub it at that subprocess/socket boundary and assert the real argv / profile contents / connect call. A test needing the real emulator legitimately SKIPS when QEMU is absent - keep those skips.
